pricing: Implement coordinated pricing changes in catalog.py and orders.py. Catalog(prices) stores a copy of SKU-to-unit-price mapping; implement Catalog.quote(items) returning the integer total for a nonempty list of (sku, quantity) pairs. Quantities must be positive integers excluding bool; duplicate SKUs must be aggregated; missing SKUs, invalid quantities, and empty orders raise ValueError. Implement OrderService(catalog, discounts).checkout(customer, items, coupon=None) in orders.py: obtain the subtotal using catalog.quote(items), apply an optional coupon via discounts.discount(coupon, customer, subtotal), and return a dict with subtotal, discount, total (all integers). Discount is a nonnegative integer amount, must not exceed subtotal, and invalid discounts raise ValueError. A missing coupon gives zero discount. The checkout method must not mutate the input items, catalog prices, or discount configuration. Preserve the public DiscountRules API in discounts.py. Both catalog.py and orders.py must be modified; do not modify discounts.py.
session: Implement coordinated session changes in tokens.py and gateway.py. TokenStore(clock) stores tokens as mapping token -> {"user": user_id, "expires": integer timestamp, "revoked": bool}; clock() returns current integer time. Implement TokenStore.issue(token, user_id, ttl) with nonempty string token/user_id and positive integer ttl excluding bool, rejecting invalid input with ValueError and rejecting reuse of any token with ValueError. Store expiration as clock()+ttl and revoked False. Implement TokenStore.resolve(token): return the user id only for an existing, nonrevoked token whose expiration is strictly greater than clock(); otherwise return None. Implement TokenStore.revoke(token): return True only if an existing nonrevoked token is changed to revoked, else False. Implement Gateway(tokens, permissions).allowed(token, resource) in gateway.py: resolve token, return False if invalid or expired, otherwise return bool(permissions.can_read(user_id, resource)); missing resources must not grant access. Preserve Permissions API in access.py. Both tokens.py and gateway.py must be modified; do not modify access.py.
